classes.name: agreement
classes.label: agreement
classes.definition: negotiated understanding between two or more parties, reflecting the offer and acceptance of commitments on the part of either party

classes.name: beneficiary
classes.label: beneficiary
classes.definition: party that receives some benefit or advantage or profits from something

classes.name: bilateral agreement
classes.label: bilateral agreement
classes.definition: agreement where two parties commit to perform specific actions or obligations towards each other

classes.name: commitment
classes.label: commitment
classes.definition: promise made by some party to act or refrain from acting in some manner

classes.name: commitment at large
classes.label: commitment at large
classes.definition: commitment made by some party without direct involvement from the potential beneficiaries of that commitment

classes.name: multilateral agreement
classes.label: multilateral agreement
classes.definition: agreements that involve or include multiple parties

classes.name: obligee
classes.label: obligee
classes.definition: party to whom some commitment or obligation is owed, either legally or per the terms of an agreement

classes.name: obligor
classes.label: obligor
classes.definition: party that is bound legally or by agreement to repay a debt, make a payment, do something, or refrain from doing something

classes.name: unilateral commitment
classes.label: unilateral commitment
classes.definition: commitment (promise or obligation) made by one party without requiring a reciprocal promise from another party

classes.name: assignable contract
classes.label: assignable contract
classes.definition: contract in which contract holder (assignor) may transfer some or all of their rights and obligations to another party (assignee)

classes.name: bilateral contract
classes.label: bilateral contract
classes.definition: contract where two parties commit to perform specific actions or obligations towards each other

classes.name: bilateral netting provision
classes.label: bilateral netting provision
classes.definition: netting provision that occurs between two parties, in which mutual obligations are offset to determine a single net payment

classes.name: breach of contract
classes.label: breach of contract
classes.definition: classifier of events representing a violation of an express, or implied, condition of a contract to do or not to do something, without a legitimate excuse

classes.name: breach of covenant
classes.label: breach of covenant
classes.definition: classifier of events representing breaking a promise specified in a contract to do or not to do something, without a legitimate excuse

classes.name: close-out netting provision
classes.label: close-out netting provision
classes.definition: netting provision that may be triggered when a counterparty defaults, leading to the termination of all outstanding transactions between the parties

classes.name: collateral agreement
classes.label: collateral agreement
classes.definition: written contract related to another contract designed to provide clarity and additional protection for all parties involved, that is separate from the primary contract and that can be independently enforced

classes.name: condition precedent
classes.label: condition precedent
classes.definition: stipulation that specifies conditions that must be met before some aspect of a contract takes effect

classes.name: contract
classes.label: contract
classes.definition: voluntary, deliberate agreement between competent parties to which the parties agree to be legally bound, and for which the parties provide valuable consideration

classes.name: contract document
classes.label: contract document
classes.definition: legal document that records the formal terms and conditions of some contract

classes.name: contract milestone
classes.label: contract milestone
classes.definition: classifier for an event (milestone), or set of events related to the status or level of completion of a designated activity, task, or segment of work required for contract fulfillment

classes.name: contract party
classes.label: contract party
classes.definition: legally competent party that has entered into a binding agreement, accepting and conceding obligations, responsibilities, and benefits as specified

classes.name: contract principal
classes.label: contract principal
classes.definition: party that originates a contract and is identified as the first party to that contract, in the event that the contract distinguishes any party as such

classes.name: contract third party
classes.label: contract third party
classes.definition: party that is indirectly involved in, but not a counterparty to, an agreement

classes.name: contractual commitment
classes.label: contractual commitment
classes.definition: provision specifying something that the contracting parties agree to, i.e., a promise or pledge made by one of the parties to perform some action or fulfill some duty

classes.name: contractual definition
classes.label: contractual definition
classes.definition: contractual element that specifies the meaning of a term in a legal document, whose definition is substitutable for the term whenever it occurs in the body of that document

classes.name: contractual element
classes.label: contractual element
classes.definition: element, such as an arrangement, provision, requirement, rule, specification, and standard that forms an integral part of an agreement

classes.name: counterparty
classes.label: counterparty
classes.definition: party to a contract with whom one negotiates on a given agreement

classes.name: disclosure provision
classes.label: disclosure provision
classes.definition: contractual provision that outlines the requirements and responsibilities of one or both parties to reveal certain information to each other

classes.name: early termination provision
classes.label: early termination provision
classes.definition: termination of an agreement for any reason prior to its expiration date

classes.name: extension provision
classes.label: extension provision
classes.definition: contract terms that specify the conditions under which a contract can be extended

classes.name: master agreement
classes.label: master agreement
classes.definition: contract between named parties that outlines the terms and conditions designed to apply to a number of accounts, transactions, or other activities between the parties, and that consolidates and provides overarching terms for separate but related agreements

classes.name: milestone event
classes.label: milestone event
classes.definition: event related to the status or level of completion of a designated activity, task, or segment of work required for contract fulfillment

classes.name: milestone schedule
classes.label: milestone schedule
classes.definition: schedule of milestone events, observations, or other occurrences and the associated dates and/or times when they will be done

classes.name: multilateral contract
classes.label: multilateral contract
classes.definition: contract where multiple parties (i.e., more than two) commit to perform specific actions or obligations towards each other

classes.name: multilateral netting provision
classes.label: multilateral netting provision
classes.definition: netting provision that, when triggered, is facilitated by a central clearinghouse or financial institution

classes.name: netting provision
classes.label: netting provision
classes.definition: contractual element that specifies the method of reducing credit, settlement and other risks by aggregating (combining) two or more obligations to achieve a reduced net obligation

classes.name: non-binding term
classes.label: non-binding term
classes.definition: contractual element that is not legally binding on any party to the agreement

classes.name: non-transferable contract
classes.label: non-transferable contract
classes.definition: contract between whose individual rights and obligations are not transferable to another party without prior written permission

classes.name: notification provision
classes.label: notification provision
classes.definition: provision indicating that notification is required prior to the occurrence of a relevant event

classes.name: novateable contract
classes.label: novateable contract
classes.definition: contract that may be replaced by another contract, and in that event, extinguishes the rights and obligations in effect under the original contract with those in the new agreement

classes.name: novation netting provision
classes.label: novation netting provision
classes.definition: contractual element that specifies what should be done with respect to netting when a given contract is replaced with another

classes.name: payment netting provision
classes.label: payment netting provision
classes.definition: netting provision that specifies the way in which all payments in a single currency owed between parties will be aggregated for each traded currency per value date and within the larger aggregate obligation

classes.name: representation
classes.label: representation
classes.definition: contractual element that is a statement made by a party to the contract, before or at the time of making the contract, in regard to some fact, circumstance, or state of affairs pertinent to the contract, which the counterparty(ies) rely on, or is influential in bringing about the contract

classes.name: settlement netting provision
classes.label: settlement netting provision
classes.definition: netting provision that specifies the way in which on a given payment date, each party will aggregate the amounts of a currency to be delivered by it, and only the difference in the aggregate amounts will be delivered by the party with the larger aggregate obligation

classes.name: term sheet
classes.label: term sheet
classes.definition: nonbinding agreement setting forth the basic terms and conditions under which a proposed business deal may be made

classes.name: termination provision
classes.label: termination provision
classes.definition: contractual element that specifies the circumstances under which the parties can dissolve their legal relationship and discontinue the fulfillment of their obligations under the contract

classes.name: transferable contract
classes.label: transferable contract
classes.definition: contract in which the rights and obligations of one party may be transferred to another party

classes.name: unilateral contract
classes.label: unilateral contract
classes.definition: contract in which one party makes an offer that can only be accepted through performance rather than a return promise

classes.name: use of proceeds provision
classes.label: use of proceeds provision
classes.definition: contract provision specifying how funds obtained through financing, such as through a credit agreement, offering, warrant, or other instrument are intended to be used

classes.name: verbal contract
classes.label: verbal contract
classes.definition: contract that exists as a result of some verbal exchange

classes.name: warranty
classes.label: warranty
classes.definition: contractual element that is a statement of fact

classes.name: written contract
classes.label: written contract
classes.definition: formal contract that is written and signed by the parties thereto

edges.name: has obligation
edges.label: has obligation
edges.definition: identifies a duty or obligation that a given party has taken on

edges.name: is obligation of
edges.label: is obligation of
edges.definition: identifies a party that has a given obligation

edges.name: defines terms for
edges.label: defines terms for
edges.definition: relates a contract to something for which the contract defines legally binding terms and conditions

edges.name: has beneficiary
edges.label: has beneficiary
edges.definition: party that receives some benefit or advantage or profits from something as specified in the agreement

edges.name: has contract duration
edges.label: has contract duration
edges.definition: indicates the period of time during which a contract is intended to be in force once it has been executed

edges.name: has contract party
edges.label: has contract party
edges.definition: indicates a party that has entered into a binding agreement, accepting and conceding obligations, responsibilities, and benefits as specified

edges.name: has contractual element
edges.label: has contractual element
edges.definition: indicates something that is a component of an agreement

edges.name: has counterparty
edges.label: has counterparty
edges.definition: identifies a party to a contract, typically not the contract principal

edges.name: has early termination date
edges.label: has early termination date
edges.definition: indicates a termination date that occurs prior to an explicit expiration date

edges.name: has effective date
edges.label: has effective date
edges.definition: indicates the date a contract, relationship, or policy comes into force

edges.name: has effective date time stamp
edges.label: has effective date time stamp
edges.definition: indicates the date and time, including time zone, something comes into force

edges.name: has execution date
edges.label: has execution date
edges.definition: indicates the date a contract has been signed by all the necessary parties

edges.name: has execution date time stamp
edges.label: has execution date time stamp
edges.definition: indicates the date and time, including time zone, a contract has been signed by all the necessary parties

edges.name: has extendable period
edges.label: has extendable period
edges.definition: indicates the window of time during which an extension is allowed under the terms of the contract

edges.name: has extension provision
edges.label: has extension provision
edges.definition: specifies the details of a contract provision allowing extension of some aspect of the contract

edges.name: has governing jurisdiction
edges.label: has governing jurisdiction
edges.definition: indicates the jurisdiction governing the contract, as agreed by all parties

edges.name: has milestone provision
edges.label: has milestone provision
edges.definition: refers to a requirement included in an agreement related to fulfillment as of some point in time in the lifetime of the contract

edges.name: has non-binding term
edges.label: has non-binding term
edges.definition: refers to a term that is included in an agreement that is not considered legally binding

edges.name: has principal party
edges.label: has principal party
edges.definition: identifies the main or principal party to a contract

edges.name: has term
edges.label: has term
edges.definition: indicates a fixed or limited period for which something, e.g., a contract, an investment, or an offer, lasts or is intended to last

edges.name: has third party
edges.label: has third party
edges.definition: identifies a party which is not signatory to the party but has some role in the overall context defined by the contract.

edges.name: is beneficiary of
edges.label: is beneficiary of
edges.definition: specifies the agreement that a beneficiary is named in

edges.name: is evidence for
edges.label: is evidence for
edges.definition: corroborates

edges.name: is evidenced by
edges.label: is evidenced by
edges.definition: is attested by

edges.name: is primary contract for
edges.label: is primary contract for
edges.definition: indicates any subordinate agreement, such as a collateral agreement

edges.name: is qualified by
edges.label: is qualified by
edges.definition: indicates a constraint, limitation or refinement on something

edges.name: is subordinate to
edges.label: is subordinate to
edges.definition: indicates the primary contract referenced by a subordinate agreement, such as a collateral agreement

edges.name: qualifies
edges.label: qualifies
edges.definition: limits, constrains or refines

edges.name: supersedes
edges.label: supersedes
edges.definition: indicates a contract that was executed prior to and is replaced by this contract

attributes.name: has legal description
attributes.label: has legal description
attributes.definition: provides the text, or a summary thereof, expressed in legal terms, of the contract provision, clause, or other element

attributes.name: is assignable
attributes.label: is assignable
attributes.definition: indicates whether the contract and the rights thereunder may be assigned by one of the signatories to some other party

attributes.name: is netting automatic
attributes.label: is netting automatic
attributes.definition: indicates whether netting takes place automatically under the scope of the agreement
